_comment: Where each source volume in tustav-pdf-extracts.json came from.
The volumes themselves live under tmp/tustav-pdfs/, which is gitignored:
they are large, they are TÜSTAV's scans rather than this archive's, and
what this repository publishes is the article-scoped extract cut from
them. Recording the addresses means the extraction stays reproducible
from a clean checkout — run `npm run recover:tustav`.
Every host here is on the allowlist in scripts/find-tustav-alpay.mjs.
